messages.content: Alian AI is the AI services division of Alian Software, an engineering firm with over 15 years of experience building production enterprise systems. We are an engineering team that specializes in shipping production-ready AI solutions—such as chatbots, agents, RAG apps, and automation pipelines—rather than just providing consulting or strategy decks. We build these systems and hand them over to your team to run, though we are available to provide support if you choose.
